references.observed: Physical sleeved full front on a stand with directional light. Foil and relief cross hood, mask, glove, green sleeve and lower garment, as well as the background and rim. Skin at eye and fingertips stays comparatively smooth. Card occupies only about 550 by 750 source pixels; line flow evidence, not enough detail for complete reconstruction.

Detailed near-flat front shows local line flow in hood, cloth mask, glove, sleeve and lower garment plus curved rim and forest patterns. Exposed skin and gray waist panel have a smoother response. Capture method unconfirmed; it cannot substitute for complementary directional physical photos.

Physical tilted full front on black patterned fabric with strong directional foil. Confirms coarse curved striae on hood, mask, glove/sleeve and lower garment, independent background flow and curved rim. Name field also shows curving surface lines under the light; do not assume the whole header is unetched. Exposed skin and orange rule-panel interior remain comparatively smooth. Some center and dark lower-left lines lack sufficient pixels for tracing.

Physical full front in rigid holder, diffuse complementary lighting. Supports different hood/garment/background line flow and largely smooth exposed skin; plastic haze softens fine lines and does not resolve the remaining individual-line gaps.
Angled physical full front on illustrated fabric under directional light. Supports hood, glove and lower garment flow; blur and washed-out reflection prevent tracing every fine line.

Detailed near-flat full front on dark background. Shows local striae in hood, sleeve, glove and lower garment. Capture method unconfirmed; combine with directional physical photographs before interpreting any fine feature as relief.

Detailed near-flat full front on white background. Clearly separates border, forest, sleeve, hood and lower-cloth line flow with unobstructed edges. Face/eye interior, fingertips and orange rule interior stay smooth. Capture method unconfirmed; use directional photographs to confirm actual relief and small eyebrow/lash regions.

Physical angled front on stand with clean directional lighting. Fine curved ridges resolve on the dark extended glove, green sleeve, cloth mask, hood and lower purple garment; the bright cloth-mask patch complements the darker user view. Skin and fingertips remain quiet next to these ridges. Gray waist remains comparatively smooth-looking, requiring macro confirmation of its transition. Stand obscures bottom center; tiny eyebrow/lash lines remain under-resolved. Exact relief is not reconstructed from this photograph.

User-provided exact-card photograph with strong directional light. Smooth exposed skin and eye interior contrast with metallic eyebrow and upper lash/eyelid response; these small features need separate foil islands and etched regions. Confirms flowing cloth, sleeve, forest and silver-border relief. Strong glare washes out the left field and lower-center/right dark lines need complementary views. This is physical surface evidence, not a height texture.

authoring: Physical angled fronts show foil over hood, cloth mask, gloves, green sleeve, lower garment, forest and silver rim, including the name field. Exposed skin, eye interior, fingertips and printed orange rule interior remain protected. The eyebrow and upper lashes are separate foil islands within the protected face, supported by the user directional photograph; their etched lines still require tracing. The metallic rule rim and TRAINER header remain foil. Gray waist area remains part of the foil sheet; smooth appearance alone is not grounds for inventing or excluding relief.
remaining: Exact etched regions, individual traced lines, height/normal/direction/roughness maps and rendered-tilt acceptance. Typography masks and coverage are implemented independently of that remaining relief work.
limitations: Coverage reconstruction from still photos. No etching map, measured grating constant or completed surface is claimed.
opaqueRegions: Exposed eye and face, with separate foil eyebrow and lashes

foilIslands.name: Etched eyebrow
foilIslands.observed: User directional photograph shows metallic etched response on the dark eyebrow, inside the otherwise protected face. Coverage only; individual relief lines remain untraced.

foilIslands.name: Etched upper eyelid and lashes
foilIslands.observed: User directional photograph reveals foil through the dark upper eyelid and individual lashes. Iris, pupil, sclera and surrounding skin remain protected. This boundary is not a relief map.
